descriptionFromApi:
Job Description Position Summary
  • Oil & Gas Sector Leader responsible for driving sector-led growth through origination, deal shaping, and execution of large-scale transformation programs, with a strong emphasis on strengthening sales enablement, pipeline quality, and strategic account penetration across the Oil & Gas portfolio.
  • Acts as a senior industry advisor, translating industry disruption, energy transition priorities, operational transformation opportunities, digital enablement, and sustainability imperatives into actionable client opportunities while building a differentiated sector proposition and positioning EY as a partner of choice for complex, high-value transformation engagements.
Objectives and Purpose
  • Drive origination and closure of large, complex transformation opportunities, translating sector priorities such as energy transition, operational excellence, digital modernization, asset optimization, and sustainability into actionable, high-value deals.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Oil & Gas C-suite leaders, shaping enterprise transformation agendas across upstream, midstream, downstream, trading, and supporting functions with a clear link to business outcomes and value realization.
  • Build and commercialize differentiated sector offerings, thought leadership, and alliance-enabled solutions while strengthening EY's market position and establishing GDS as a strategic partner for enterprise-scale transformation across the Oil & Gas value chain.
Scope of the Position
  • Drive the GDS Oil & Gas sector agenda across priority accounts, aligning global client needs with GDS capabilities to identify, shape, and scale high-value transformation opportunities across the upstream, midstream, downstream, and energy trading value chain.
  • Lead end-to-end pursuit lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, solution shaping, commercial structuring, and deal closure, ensuring strong integration with global account teams and regional industry leadership.
  • Drive sales enablement at scale through disciplined pipeline management, pursuit governance, sector narratives, and reusable playbooks that improve win rates and accelerate revenue growth.
  • Lead integrated go-to-market initiatives across Consulting, Technology, Tax, Assurance, Strategy & Transactions, and Alliances to deliver differentiated, market-facing Oil & Gas solutions.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with Oil & Gas clients, engaging C-suite stakeholders to shape transformation agendas focused on operational excellence, asset productivity, cost optimization, sustainability, and enterprise modernization.
  • Develop and commercialize sector-specific assets, benchmarks, and accelerators that enable faster deal shaping, repeatable delivery, and differentiated positioning in the marketplace.
  • Guide clients in transforming hydrocarbon value chain operations through digital field operations, production optimization, integrated planning, supply chain modernization, and AI-enabled decision intelligence.
  • Advise clients on energy transition and asset-intensive transformation priorities, including decarbonization strategies, asset lifecycle management, capital project optimization, and the application of digital technologies to improve production performance, reliability, and operational resilience.
Essential Functions
  • Institutionalize sector-led sales excellence by defining pursuit methodologies, qualification frameworks, commercial governance processes, and executive sponsorship models that improve consistency and effectiveness across strategic opportunities.
  • Lead the development and commercialization of Oil & Gas sector intellectual property, including industry frameworks, benchmarks, solution accelerators, and differentiated assets that strengthen EY's market proposition.
  • Establish and govern strategic alliances and ecosystem relationships, enabling the development of integrated solutions that enhance client value and expand EY's relevance across the Oil & Gas landscape.
  • Sponsor capability building across GDS by developing sector talent, strengthening industry acumen, and fostering a high-performing team with deep Oil & Gas domain expertise.
  • Guide the evolution of GDS delivery models for the sector, ensuring the effective integration of consulting, technology, data, and managed services capabilities to support large-scale transformation programs.
  • Advise clients on operational and asset-intensive transformation priorities, including production optimization, asset lifecycle management, maintenance effectiveness, and digital operations initiatives that improve efficiency, reliability, and business performance.
  • Provide thought leadership on industry disruption themes, including energy transition, decarbonization, carbon management, and emerging energy business models, helping clients navigate strategic choices while positioning EY as a trusted transformation partner.
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities
  • Assess emerging industry trends and disruption themes, including energy transition, commodity price volatility, regulatory developments, decarbonization priorities, and changing demand patterns, to inform sector strategy and long-term investment decisions.
  • Determine the strategic focus of sector offerings and solutions, evaluating market opportunities, client demand signals, and competitive differentiation to guide the development and commercialization of new capabilities.
  • Analyze complex transformation opportunities and client business cases, balancing expected business value, implementation feasibility, risk exposure, and resource requirements to recommend the most effective transformation pathways.
  • Provide strategic direction on operational and asset-intensive improvement initiatives, evaluating trade-offs across production performance, asset reliability, capital efficiency, sustainability objectives, and long-term value creation to support executive decision making.
Education and Experience
  • 25+ years of relevant experience in consulting (Big 4 / strategy consulting) and/or senior industry leadership roles within the Oil & Gas sector, with a demonstrated track record of driving growth, transformation, operational improvement, and business-led change initiatives.
  • Proven experience advising and influencing C-suite stakeholders across global Oil & Gas organizations, including leading large-scale transformation programs, strategic pursuits, and complex business development opportunities.
  • Demonstrated success in building and scaling sector practices, developing differentiated offerings, shaping go-to-market strategies, and driving revenue growth in matrixed, global organizations.
  • Experience building and leveraging ecosystem-led solutions with technology partners such as AspenTech, AVEVA, SLB, Halliburton Landmark, Baker Hughes, Emerson, Honeywell, SAP, Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Databricks, translating technology capabilities into differentiated transformation propositions and measurable business outcomes for clients.
  • Strong academic background, with an MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred; undergraduate degree in engineering, business, geosciences, energy management, technology, or a related discipline typically expected.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

Our Engineering team is revolutionizing how Appian resolves customer issues by building AI-powered diagnostic tools and internal platforms that dramatically reduce resolution time. We combine deep technical expertise with AI innovation to empower support engineers to identify root causes faster, ensuring our customers experience uninterrupted business-critical operations. This team operates with high autonomy and directly impacts customer satisfaction and retention across Appians enterprise client base.

The Opportunity: Appian is at an inflection point where intelligent automation meets customer success, and we need a technical leader who can architect and ship the next generation of diagnostic platforms. This role exists because our growing enterprise customer base demands faster, smarter issue resolution, and AI agents are the key to unlocking that scale. You will shape both the technical direction and the team culture while delivering tools that become essential to how Appian supports thousands of mission-critical deployments worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and delivery of a scalable AI-powered triage platform that reduces mean time to resolution by leveraging AI agents, LangChain frameworks, and intelligent diagnostics
  • Lead the engineering team building AI-powered diagnostic tools that cut customer issue resolution time in half while scaling a platform that empowers support engineers across the globe.
  • Architect quarterly releases of diagnostic tools on AWS infrastructure, balancing innovation velocity with production stability and security requirements
  • Build and grow a high-performing engineering team through effective people management, technical mentorship, and career development focused on AI and cloud-native technologies
  • Partner with Customer Success and Product leadership to translate support pain points into engineering roadmaps that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction
  • Drive technical excellence through hands-on code reviews in Python and AI frameworks while establishing engineering best practices for the team
  • Execute stakeholder management across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams to align priorities and communicate progress on platform capabilities

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Hold a Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related STEM field
  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in software engineering with at least 2+ years in engineering management or technical leadership roles
  • AI Fluency: Proven fluency in AI and LLMs, encompassing both the strategic development of AI-powered platform capabilities and the hands-on application of AI tools to accelerate daily workflows
  • Python Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python with demonstrated experience building production-grade applications and diagnostic tools
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience designing and deploying scalable systems on AWS with knowledge of cloud-native architectures
  • AI Agent Development: Experience building AI agents and working with frameworks such as LangChain or similar orchestration tools
  • People Leadership: Proven track record managing engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and technical mentorship
  • Technical Collaboration: Active participation in code reviews and ability to balance hands-on technical contributions with leadership responsibilities
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong communication skills with experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and translating business needs into technical solutions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Customer Support Domain: Experience building tools or platforms for customer support, site reliability, or operations teams
  • Diagnostic Systems: Background in observability, monitoring, troubleshooting tools, or root cause analysis platforms
  • Enterprise SaaS: Experience working in enterprise software companies with complex multi-tenant architectures
  • Ecosystem Experience: We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment
